subject: MPL kickoff — squeezing accuracy out of 10% of the labels
body:
Team,

Kicking off the Meta Pseudo Labels integration. Why: several vision customers have huge unlabeled pools and tiny labeled sets, and our open-source MPL work is the strongest teacher-student recipe we own for that regime — the released implementation covers the two low-resource benchmarks, CIFAR-10-4000 and ImageNet-10%.

Milestones (window closes 05-04):
- 03-06: CIFAR-10-4000 reproduction with the wrn-28-2 config on our accelerator quota, matching published accuracy.
- 04-03: ImageNet-10% reproduction with resnet-50; training-cost profile documented.
- 04-27: proposal for the Q3 scaled run on the internal low-label datasets, with a real budget attached — this thing is compute-hungry and I don't want a surprise in July.

Note the released code is TPU-only, so we run on our cirrus quota — Santiago will confirm feasibility. Umar is TL.

Lucia
